nodes.label: P03 Commercial Intelligence
nodes.rationale: What things cost, who can make them, how long they take, and where each answer came from: a price with no source is a rumour.

nodes.label: ADR-0135
nodes.rationale: P03 compares, ranks and recommends and never places an order, awards business, approves a supplier or commits expenditure.

nodes.label: CommercialQuality
nodes.rationale: A second axis from ReferenceValidationState saying whether a figure is still worth using; IsDecisionGrade only for Verified; the weakest governs; an empty set is Incomplete because absence of contradicting evidence is not evidence.

nodes.label: CostFigure
nodes.rationale: Wraps Money with a certainty and a range; no averaging or midpoint shortcut because choosing which end to believe is a commercial judgement, not an operation.

nodes.label: LeadTimeDuration
nodes.rationale: A working day is not a duration (ADR-0133): keeps its own unit, refuses to convert working days to elapsed time and throws on incomparable ordering.

nodes.label: Absence Is Never Permission
nodes.rationale: An unstated GeographicScope covers nothing, AppliesTo never matches on an absent dimension, an undated source reads as older than any threshold.

nodes.label: P03 Validation Prefixes
nodes.rationale: TEMPEST-CID, CIP, CIL, CIQ, CIS over the shared CIC.

nodes.label: SupplierIdentity
nodes.rationale: Identity is recorded and never merged; only a registration-number match is conclusive, everything else is a possible duplicate for a person.

nodes.label: CapabilityAssurance
nodes.rationale: NotAssessed to Offered to Verified to Proven, with Declined and Disproven; every value names who established what; nothing approves a supplier.

nodes.label: ProcessCostRecord
nodes.rationale: What a process costs from a supplier, at a quantity, on a date, linked to P01 A7 by ProcessRecordId; A7 says what a process is, D2 what it costs.

nodes.label: CostBasis
nodes.rationale: Decides whether TotalFor can scale a figure at all; unscalable bases return null rather than a plausible wrong number.

nodes.label: Strongest Claim First
nodes.rationale: FindApplicableAsync returns the firmest statement first but returns the rest too, because weaker figures are frequently the more realistic ones.

nodes.label: Four Quote Types
nodes.rationale: CostEstimate binds nobody, SupplierQuote binds the supplier if firm, CustomerQuotation binds the organisation once issued, RealisedOutcome is what happened (ADR-0134).

nodes.label: EstimateLine SourcePins
nodes.rationale: Every line pins library, record and revision so a historical estimate resolves the figures actually used.

nodes.label: EstimatingService.ReproduceAsync
nodes.rationale: Re-reads the pins and reports where libraries have moved; never alters the estimate.

nodes.label: Unknowns Propagate
nodes.rationale: An estimate with one unpriced line has no total, rather than a total certainly too small.

nodes.label: Issued Quotation Needs Authority
nodes.rationale: A CustomerQuotation recorded as issued must name who issued it and the authority held; validation raises an error not a warning.

nodes.label: SourcingRequirement
nodes.rationale: States criteria before candidates are assessed and is governed in its own right so weights cannot be reshaped around the answer somebody wanted.

nodes.label: SourcingComparisonService
nodes.rationale: Pure and deterministic, tie-broken on ordinal code; absent information is never scored as zero but becomes an outstanding question; excluded candidates stay in the record with the failed criterion.

nodes.label: RecommendationStrength
nodes.rationale: Insufficient, Provisional, Marginal, Clear: a statement about the comparison, not a confidence percentage.

nodes.label: AlternativeChosen
nodes.rationale: Disagreeing with the recommendation is a first-class outcome.

nodes.label: What P03 Will Not Do
nodes.rationale: Award, approve, accept, issue, commit, convert currency or convert working days; enforced by a reflection test over every type in the namespace.

nodes.label: P03 Libraries Ship Empty
nodes.rationale: Real commercial intelligence is business data belonging to the organisation; fabricating it would produce records indistinguishable in shape and wrong in every particular.

nodes.label: P03 Depends on P07 and P01
nodes.rationale: Money and periods from P07, record identities from P01 cited by Id and never duplicated; independent of P02.

hyperedges.label: Second-Axis Standing Vocabularies Beside the Record Lifecycle
